scope: Contrast >=4.5:1 / RGPD consent + opt-out / modal dialog ARIA / screenshot drift visual

modal_dialog_aria_findings.title: ModalShell emits proper role='dialog' + aria-modal + ESC handler + initial focus
modal_dialog_aria_findings.evidence: Wrapper accepts labelledBy + dataModalKind. Sheet has role='dialog' aria-modal='true' aria-labelledby={labelledBy}. useEffect installs keydown ESC handler. Initial focus moved to first focusable inside sheet via querySelector('button, [href], input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not("-1")'). Backdrop has aria-hidden='true'. Drag handle aria-hidden='true'. Per A11-006 P1 round-3 2026-05-11 spec.

modal_dialog_aria_findings.title: All 6 modals labelled (no orphan dialogs)
modal_dialog_aria_findings.file_line: mobile/screens-modals.jsx (ModalPayChoice:43, ModalPointsGain:124, ModalCardLink:181, ModalWalletV0Notice:284, ModalOptOutConfirm:316) + mobile/components/WizardRedeem.jsx:136

modal_dialog_aria_findings.title: WizardRedeem 3-step has accessible step indicator + dynamic title + role='alert' on errors
modal_dialog_aria_findings.evidence: StepDots: role='group' aria-label='Étape X sur 3'. Error banner: role='alert'. Buttons: aria-busy={inflight}. Step 3 success container: data-testid='redeem-success' + replay banner role='status'.

rgpd_findings.title: RGPD opt-out flow complete (consent gate + confirm modal + art. 17 erasure)
rgpd_findings.evidence: ScreenLoyalty reads window.LC.storage.getConsent(). When 'opted_out': hides POINTS tab content + shows reactivation prompt with art. 17 explanation. ModalOptOutConfirm displays current balance + 'Tes {balance} points actuels seront effacés (droit à l'effacement, RGPD article 17). Cette action est irréversible.'. Uses red bg + explicit Désactiver CTA.

rgpd_findings.title: localStorage cleanup on logout includes loyalty-related state (no cross-user leak)
rgpd_findings.evidence: On logout: remove('auth'/'cart'/'loyalty'/'loyalty_consent'/'loyalty_idempotency'/'loyalty_pending_redemption'/'redeemed_keys'/'wallet_apple_dismissed_at'/'wallet_google_dismissed_at'). Triggers LC.loyalty._rehydrate() to reset in-memory state. Prevents next user inheriting idempotency keys / consent flag.

rgpd_findings.title: No first-launch RGPD consent banner present
rgpd_findings.evidence: grep -E 'RGPD|consent|cookie' in mobile/*.jsx = only opt-out flow + ScreenLoyalty consent gate hits. No global first-launch banner (typical for fast-food mobile prototype — onboarding implies consent). CNIL guidance suggests explicit cookie banner for marketing tracking; here mobile is standalone V0 with no third-party tracking, so absence is defensible but worth flagging for V1 production review.
rgpd_findings.recommendation: If production release adds analytics SDK (Firebase / Sentry replay / GA), add first-launch consent screen before tracking init. V1.0.2 if analytics added.

contrast_findings.title: Contrast >=4.5:1 attestation per cfa9ec679 + design-perfect round-3 baseline
contrast_findings.evidence: inspect-contrast.spec uses axe-core 4.10 runOnly:['color-contrast'] across home screen. Round-3 design-perfect cycle closed with 0 color-contrast violations. Visible palette confirmed: --orange (#FF5A1F) on white, --ink (#0A0A0A) on yellow/cream, --green (#1FA653) on green-light, --red on white. Manual review of A01-home + Z00-home-overview screenshots: all visible text >=4.5:1.

screenshot_drift_findings.title: Dirty screenshots (A01-home + Z00-home-overview) are sub-pixel regen drift only
screenshot_drift_findings.evidence: Origin commit: 27ef0aa85 'chore(goal-mission-2026-05-18): Round 3 validator screenshot regenerations'. Visual content identical: BONSOIR/IKYES greeting + LE CAYENNE branding + OUVERT status + 11 categories + ACCUEIL/MENU/COMMANDES/PROFIL tab bar. Sole micro-diff: horizontal scroll position of orange marquee ("SAUCE CAYENNE MAISON · SANDWICHS FALUCHE") — text starts at 'E CAYENNE' (A01) vs 'UCE CAYENNE' (Z00). This is animation-tick variance from regen, not a regression. No layout break, no raw labels, no fictional products visible.
screenshot_drift_findings.investigation_verdict: BENIGN — sub-pixel regen drift, not session-A WIP, no rollback needed.
